proposals.impact: lift Money Worship open rate to match Vigilance baseline
proposals.observation: Money Vigilance automation: 12 sent, 66.67% open rate. Money Worship automation: 16 sent, 37.5% open rate. That is a 29-point gap on a comparable send volume. The Vigilance subject line is clearly pulling harder. The Worship sequence is the one most likely to speak to the ICP who earns well but does not build — the person who ties self-worth to income and overspends on status — so a weak open rate there means the warmest leads are not reading the emails most relevant to them.
proposals.proposal: Rewrite the subject line of Email 1 in the Money Worship automation. The current subject is almost certainly generic ("your relationship with money" or similar). Replace it with a subject that names the specific felt experience of a Money Worship pattern without using any banned phrasing. The body copy does not change — this is a subject-line-only edit.
